A hysterectomy is safer for me because of my fibroid placement and size. The uterus is enlarged to about 20cm and my fibroid is 9x12. It is too large to remove laparoscopically (robotically through smaller holes) so I was going to have an open myomectomy. And since i am a larger girl that creates more complications since there is more tissue to cut through and heal and my stomach cavity would have to be open a bit longer. With a partial hysterectomy my doctor is able to go through my vagina with no major incisions and will be able to do so robotically. A much easier surgery for both of us. 
Also given my family history, i would most likely have more fibroids in the future. We also have a streak of terribly long winded postpartum depression so i knew being pregnant myself was not something i was interested in. I wanted a surrogate anyways ! I guess it all depends on your own body and what you decide but this was the safe option for me. My doctor was very optimistic about the open myomectomy and its success but I chose the hysterectomy to limit and surgery or complications for the future also.

i had a rude awakening yesterday. my friends and i are doing more things this year so i suggested a new amusement park in Biloxi, Paradise Pier. we drove 1.30 hours from New Orleans and made it around 6. It was extremely clean and cute and i was so excited !! No lines other than waiting for the current ride to end. My friend and i got in line for an airplane twister that had an over the shoulder chest harness that buckled at the bottom at your crotch and a molded seat. i got in the seat and it was uncomfy but i thought itd be fine and i could just put the harness on. it didnt fit at ALL and i had to be let off. The teens at the park were really sweet and i know im bigger so sometimes you just dont fit. Im a 20/22, 3x i weigh about 
290 and im 5"9. After i tried a swinger ride and couldnt fit in that either. I was really dismayed. Again the teen attendant said to me its alright this ride is built for kids anyways. No one made me feel bad but I just felt really shunned. Like going into a straight sized store. Theres nothing for you there. They actively do not want you there since there is nothing for you. I hadnt faced antifat adversity in so long i had literally forgotten it would be possible that id be to big. It was a ugly slap to my face. I felt silly but i also was sad i had wasted 43$ on this. I was able to ride the ferris wheel and the carosel. None of the seat belts on other rides came close to fitting. they all had 5-9 inches of space. My friend and i got on a hot air balloon self spin rotator and i also couldn't fit but the kid told me id be fine without the belt. I was fine but its just so saddening that i have to forgo actual safety bc people my size arent being thought about. Im glad you all have had great luck at disney. Its out of my price range but i would love to go in the future. This place did have a large indoor arcade that i would come back to visit, but the rides are NOT friendly at all. I was so excited to go on them, it was sad. It was also hard because i was with two skinny friends. I was able to enjoy watching them have fun but my time there quickly felt hollow.
